2556.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Police Dismantle Kratos Phishing Kit Built to Steal Microsoft 365 Sessions and B
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("node.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2556.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Police Dismantle Kratos Phishing Kit Built to Steal Microsoft 365 Sessions and B ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("node.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("node.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2557.def:

| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("barr.svg","lg.svg")
| extend Host = tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host)

description: Detects HTTP requests to the WordPress core REST batch endpoint (/wp-json/batch/v1 or rest_route=/batch/v1) carrying author_exclude/author__not_in SQL injection tokens used by the wp2shell pre-auth RCE (CVE-2026-63030 + CVE-2026-60137).
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/unauthenticated-rce-in-wordpress-wp2shell
  - https://slcyber.io/research-center/wp2shell-pre-authentication-rce-in-wordpress-core/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/18
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1505.003
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_path:
    - cs-uri-stem|contains: '/batch/v1'
    - cs-uri-query|contains: 'rest_route=/batch/v1'
  selection_sqli:
    - cs-uri-query|contains: 'author_exclude'
    - cs-uri-query|contains: 'author__not_in'
    - cs-uri-query|contains: 'SLEEP('
  condition: selection_path and selection_sqli
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate applications performing bulk operations through the REST batch endpoint (rare, and would not carry SQLi tokens)
level: high
2718.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.uri_path="*/batch/v1*" OR Web.url="*/wp-json/batch/v1*" OR Web.uri_query="*rest_route=/batch/v1*") by Web.src, Web.dest, Web.site, Web.http_method, Web.uri_path, Web.uri_query, Web.url, Web.status, Web.http_user_agent
| `drop_dm_object_name("Web")`
| where http_method IN ("POST","PUT","PATCH","DELETE") OR like(uri_query,"%author_exclude%") OR like(uri_query,"%author__not_in%") OR like(url,"%author_exclude%") OR like(url,"%SLEEP(%") OR like(uri_query,"%NOT IN%")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime

2721.def:
// Direct build-version hunt — catches HollowByte-vulnerable OpenSSL even where the CVE-2026-34183 proxy is patched but the un-numbered fix was not backported.
DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory
| where SoftwareVendor has "openssl" or SoftwareName has "openssl"
| extend Parts = split(SoftwareVersion, ".")
| extend Major = toint(Parts[0]), Minor = toint(Parts[1]), Patch = toint(Parts[2])
| where (Major == 3 and Minor == 0 and Patch < 21)   // 3.0.x fixed at 3.0.21
     or (Major == 3 and Minor == 4 and Patch < 6)    // 3.4.x fixed at 3.4.6
     or (Major == 3 and Minor == 5 and Patch < 7)    // 3.5.x fixed at 3.5.7
     or (Major == 3 and Minor == 6 and Patch < 3)    // 3.6.x fixed at 3.6.3
     or (Major == 4 and Minor == 0 and Patch < 1)    // 4.0.x fixed at 4.0.1
     or (Major == 3 and Minor in (1, 2, 3))          // EOL 3.x branches, no HollowByte fix shipped
| project DeviceName, DeviceId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, OSPlatform, EndOfSupportStatus
| sort by SoftwareVersion asc
2721.sent:
// Proxy hunt: TVM still flags this OpenSSL for CVE-2026-34183 (shipped in the same 2026-06-09 release as the un-numbered HollowByte fix) => build predates the fix => also HollowByte-vulnerable.
DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where SoftwareName has "openssl"
| where CveId == "CVE-2026-34183"
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, DeviceId, SoftwareVendor, SoftwareName, SoftwareVersion, CveId, VulnerabilitySeverityLevel, RecommendedSecurityUpdate
| sort by DeviceName asc
2721.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Vulnerabilities.Vulnerabilities where Vulnerabilities.cve="CVE-2026-34183" by Vulnerabilities.dest, Vulnerabilities.signature, Vulnerabilities.severity, Vulnerabilities.cve
| `drop_dm_object_name(Vulnerabilities)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| sort - lastTime

2722.sent:

2722.sigma:
title: OpenSSL TLS Server Killed by Linux OOM-Killer (HollowByte Memory Exhaustion)
id: 6b2f1d84-9c3a-4e57-bf20-8a1c7d0e5b91
status: experimental
description: Detects the Linux OOM-killer terminating an OpenSSL-linked TLS-terminating service (nginx/httpd/haproxy/stunnel), the impact signature of the HollowByte length-over-allocation DoS whose freed buffers never return to the kernel on glibc.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/openssl-hollowbyte-flaw-could-freeze.html
  - https://sec.okta.com/articles/2026/06/openssl-hollowbtye-a-dos-hiding-in-11-bytes/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/18
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1499.004
logsource:
  product: linux
detection:
  keywords_oom:
    - 'Out of memory: Killed process'
    - 'oom-kill:'
    - 'oom_reaper'
  keywords_proc:
    - 'nginx'
    - 'httpd'
    - 'apache2'
    - 'haproxy'
    - 'stunnel'
    - 'openssl'
  condition: keywords_oom and keywords_proc
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate memory pressure on undersized hosts unrelated to TLS
  - Application memory leaks in the web server itself
level: medium
2722.spl:
index=* (sourcetype=syslog OR sourcetype=linux_messages_syslog OR source="/var/log/messages" OR source="/var/log/syslog") ("Out of memory: Killed process" OR "oom-kill:" OR "oom_reaper") (nginx OR openssl OR httpd OR apache2 OR haproxy OR stunnel OR "nginx: worker")
| stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(_raw) as sampleMessage by host
| where count >= 2
| sort - count
2722.datadog: source:linux.syslog ("Out of memory: Killed process" OR oom-kill OR oom_reaper) (nginx OR httpd OR apache2 OR haproxy OR stunnel OR openssl)

2749.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — ACR Stealer Uses ClickFix Lures to Steal Browser Tokens and Microsoft 365 Files
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("conhost.exe", "pythonw.exe") or FolderPath has_any ("C:\Windows\system32\rundll32.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\Windows\system32\rundll32.exe") or FileName in~ ("conhost.exe", "pythonw.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
